products.title: Enebe Phoenix Attack 16k Blue 2027 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE PHOENIX ATTACK 16K BLUE 2027 - Racquet with a lot of personality, designed for those who want to command the net and hit with determination. Its 16K carbon faces, HR3 Black EVA rubber and its elongated handle offer a firm, powerful and precise hit. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The new ENEBE PHOENIX ATTACK 16K BLUE 2027 is a racket with which Enebe once again bets on innovation, on a racket that helps you in everything and makes you feel comfortable from the first moment.

PLAYER TYPE

Racquet focused on backhand players, because its shape, handle and balance will give you great performance in attack, but it is also one of those padel rackets that generates high control.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Enebe Padel has us very accustomed to padel rackets with Premium materials with a very competent quality-price ratio. This model has 16K carbon faces and an HR3 Black EVA core, a combination that provides firmness, good recovery and a strong response when accelerating.

Its full carbon construction in the frame, heart and handle reinforces the structure, while the Stability Crossbar helps prevent twisting and maintain precision even in off-center impacts. It also incorporates Impact Marks, a 3D roughness designed to grip the ball in different directions and facilitate spin.

Its hybrid format and elongated handle provide greater leverage in shots and overhead hits, completing an offensive racket that also stands out for its stability and ease of handling.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.
